details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is 6, while the predicted answer is 7. The numerical answer contradicts the target.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. Citation [2] lists maximum masses for the heaviest living animals. 2. Six listed animals have maximum masses exceeding 60 tonnes: the blue, North Pacific right, southern right, fin, bowhead, and North Atlantic right whales. The sperm whale is listed at 57 tonnes, below the threshold. 3. Thus citation [2] supports the gold answer of 6. Citations [1] and [4] give the sperm whale a maximum mass of 80 tonnes, which would instead yield 7; the retrieved sources therefore contain a conflicting figure.
